profile_text.body:
Ericsson is a public company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, traded under the ticker ERIC. Its own site describes it as powering the networks that connect billions, working across 5G, AI, and cloud for communications service providers and enterprises. The company says it helps providers and enterprises unlock what connectivity can do, and it markets secure, reliable enterprise connectivity that unites 5G, AI, and cloud across people, devices, and locations.

Much of the site's material is framed around where networks are heading. Ericsson's CTO writes about four shifts shaping the network into what the company calls a programmable, autonomous, and AI-native intelligent fabric. The company presents perspectives on 6G as an intelligent fabric connecting people and machines through mobile, cloud, and AI systems, on building trusted AI for networks, and on AI moving into the physical world and what that could mean for the role of communications service providers in the AI economy. It also describes advanced 5G capabilities, network slicing, orchestration, and AI-driven tools, and cites AT&T's Open Radio Access Network transformation as laying the foundation for an open, disaggregated, and programmable network.

The company's record includes a CIK filing identifier, 0000717826, and the alias ERICSSON (LM) TEL-SP ADR. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
